texts.facts: The petitioners at present are working as Food Safety Officers in the Commissionerate of Food Safety at various places. Initially, they are the employees of Health and Family Welfare Service Department. They are working as Food Safety Officers since 2011 in pursuance to the notification dated 30.07.2011 (Annexure-A7) and notification dated 05.08.2011 (Annexure-A8). Under Official Memorandum (OM) dated 25.07.2025 (Annexure- A33), the petitioners are relieved as Food Safety Officers and are directed to report to duty at the Office of NC: 2025:KHC:32060-DB HC-KAR Commissioner, Health and Family Welfare Services as Junior/Senior Health Inspectors and to seek further posting. Questioning the said OM and other allied prayers, the petitioners were before the Tribunal in Application Nos.3561-3579/2025. The petitioners had also sought for interim prayer to stay the impugned OM dated 23.07.2025 (Annexure-A32) and 25.07.2025 (Annexure-A33). Under impugned order dated 06.08.2025, the Tribunal rejected the petitioners interim prayer to stay the OM's dated 23.07.2025 (Annexure-A32) and 25.07.2025 (Annexure- A33).
